Root.description:
Groups all parts of the collapsible.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the collapsible panel is initially open. To render a controlled collapsible, use the `open` prop instead.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the collapsible panel is currently open. To render an uncontrolled collapsible, use the `defaultOpen` prop instead.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the panel is opened or closed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-closed
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible is closed.

dataAttributes.name: data-starting-style
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible begins animating in.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible is animating out.

additionalTypes.name: Root.State
Root.ChangeEventDetails

Trigger.description:
A button that opens and closes the collapsible panel.
Renders a `<button>` element.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-panel-open
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible panel is open.

additionalTypes.name: Trigger.State

Panel.description:
A panel with the collapsible contents.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: hiddenUntilFound
props.description:
Allows the browser's built-in page search to find and expand the panel contents. Overrides the `keepMounted` prop and uses `hidden="until-found"`
to hide the element without removing it from the DOM.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description:
Whether to keep the element in the DOM while the panel is hidden.
This prop is ignored when `hiddenUntilFound` is used.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible panel is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-closed
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible panel is closed.

dataAttributes.name: data-starting-style
dataAttributes.description: Present when the panel begins animating in.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present when the panel is animating out.

additionalTypes.name: Panel.State
